overview: The Medford City Council met to adopt the 2025 Hazard Mitigation Plan, update the Tree Warden pay grade, and discuss various ordinance amendments. The council also tabled a $250,000 free cash appropriation for the Affordable Housing Trust until upcoming budget reviews.

items.title: Condolences to the Family of Mimi Gordon
items.summary: Approved a resolution offering condolences to the family and friends of Mimi Gordon and commemorating her life as a community activist.

items.title: First Responders and Veterans Recovery Group Resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution promoting a weekly recovery meeting for first responders and veterans dealing with substance use disorder.

items.title: Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved committee reports and minutes from meetings held on May 12th, 13th, 19th, and 20th.

items.title: Welcoming City Ordinance Amendments
items.summary: Referred proposed amendments to the Welcoming City Ordinance to the Committee on Public Health and Community Safety.

items.title: Urban Forestry Management Plan Recommendations
items.summary: Referred the Urban Forestry Management Plan recommendations to the Public Works and Facilities Committee.

items.title: Zoning Amendment Public Hearing: Fractional Units
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on proposed fractional zoning amendments to July 14th to allow staff to evaluate new pricing benchmarks.

items.title: Free Cash Appropriation for Affordable Housing Trust
items.summary: Tabled a request to appropriate $250,000 from free cash to the Affordable Housing Trust to allow the council to consider it alongside the overall operating budget.

items.title: Herb Chambers Toyota Boston Licenses
items.summary: Approved Class 1 auto sales and Class 4 auto repair licenses for Asbury Boston T, LLC, doing business as Herb Chambers Toyota Boston.

items.title: Do Not Knock Registry Ordinance Amendment
items.summary: Referred proposed updates to the Do Not Knock Registry ordinance, including licensing and background check procedures, to the Subcommittee on Licensing, Permitting, and Signs.

items.title: Board and Commission Appointments
items.summary: Approved the appointments of Linda Arrini to the Community Garden Commission, Kayla Lesson to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board, and Mary Lee to the Zoning Board of Appeals.

items.title: Donation Acceptance: Office of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion
items.summary: Approved a donation of up to $1,000 from Stop and Shop to the Office of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion.

items.title: Hazard Mitigation Plan 2025 Adoption
items.summary: Adopted a resolution approving the City of Medford Hazard Mitigation Plan 2025 update to secure eligibility for federal disaster mitigation grants.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendment: Tree Warden
items.summary: Approved an amendment to the personnel ordinance increasing the pay grade and hours of the Tree Warden position to establish it as head of the DPW's Forestry Division.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard public comment from Micah Kesselman regarding municipal immigration policies and national and local Islamophobic incidents.
